fields.name: sedation_anesthesia_permit_types
fields.description: The distinct categories of sedation and anesthesia permits a dentist may obtain beyond basic local anesthesia, each requiring separate training and board approval.
fields.sample_quote: no dentist shall use general anesthesia on an outpatient basis for dental patients, unless the dentist possesses a permit of authorization issued by the board

fields.name: sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_required
fields.description: Whether the board may require an on-site inspection of the facility, equipment, and personnel before issuing or renewing a sedation or anesthesia permit.
fields.sample_quote: Prior to the issuance or renewal of a permit for the use of deep sedation or general anesthesia, the board may, at its discretion, require an onsite inspection and evaluation of the licentiate and the facility, equipment, personnel, and procedures utilized by the licentiate.

fields.name: sedation_adverse_event_reporting_required
fields.description: Whether licensees are required to report deaths, injuries, or other adverse events resulting from sedation or anesthesia to the board within a specified timeframe.
fields.sample_quote: All licensees engaged in the practice of dentistry in the state must submit a complete report within a period of 30 days to the Board of Dental Examiners of any mortality or other incident occurring in the outpatient facilities of such dentist which results in permanent physical or mental injury of the patient as a direct result of general anesthesia or sedation techniques.

fields.name: pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required
fields.description: Whether a separate pediatric endorsement on a sedation or anesthesia permit is required before administering sedation to patients below a specified age threshold.
fields.sample_quote: A dentist shall possess a pediatric endorsement of their general anesthesia permit to administer or order the administration of deep sedation or general anesthesia to patients under seven years of age.

fields.name: specialist_license_available
fields.description: Whether the state issues a separate specialist license or certificate allowing a dentist to hold themselves out to the public as a specialist in a recognized branch of dentistry.
fields.sample_quote: A licensed dentist may not represent to the public to be qualified in a specialized branch of dentistry through any means of public advertising using the term 'specialist,' the name of a specialty, or a phrase that would suggest to the public that the dentist is a qualified specialist in a branch of dentistry unless the dentist has a specialist license in that branch as provided in this chapter.

fields.name: specialty_practice_scope_restriction
fields.description: Whether a dentist who obtains a specialist license is restricted to practicing only within that specialty branch.
fields.sample_quote: The practice of a dentist who obtains a specialist license under (a) of this section is limited to the branch of dentistry in which the dentist holds a specialist license.

fields.name: specialty_advertising_disclaimer_required
fields.description: Whether dentists who advertise a practice emphasis in an area not recognized as a specialty by the board must include a specific statutory disclaimer in their advertising.
fields.sample_quote: a dentist who lacks membership in or certification, diplomate status, or other similar credentials from an accrediting organization approved as bona fide by the board may announce a practice emphasis in any other area of dental practice if the dentist incorporates in capital letters or some other manner clearly distinguishable from the rest of the announcement, solicitation, or advertisement the following statement: '_____________ (NAME OF ANNOUNCED AREA OF DENTAL PRACTICE) IS NOT RECOGNIZED AS A SPECIALTY AREA BY THE BOARD OF DENTAL EXAMINERS OF ALABAMA.'

fields.name: dental_hygienist_supervision_levels
fields.description: The defined levels of dentist supervision under which dental hygienists may perform procedures, as enumerated in statute.
fields.sample_quote: 'direct supervision' means the dentist is in the dental office, personally diagnoses the condition to be treated, personally authorizes the procedure, and before dismissal of the patient evaluates the performance of the dental hygienist; 'general supervision' means the dentist has authorized the procedures and they are being carried out in accordance with the dentist's diagnosis and treatment plan; 'indirect supervision' means a licensed dentist is in the dental facility, authorizes the procedures, and remains in the dental facility while the procedures are being performed by the dental hygienist

fields.name: collaborative_agreement_available
fields.description: Whether the state authorizes a formal written collaborative agreement between a dentist and a dental hygienist that allows the hygienist to provide specified services without the dentist's physical presence.
fields.sample_quote: a licensed dental hygienist with a minimum of 4,000 documented hours of clinical experience within the five years preceding application for the board's approval may enter into a collaborative agreement with a licensed dentist in which the licensed dentist authorizes the licensed dental hygienist to perform one or more of the following

fields.name: collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_per_dentist
fields.description: The maximum number of collaborative or affiliated practice agreements a single dentist may hold simultaneously with dental hygienists.
fields.sample_quote: the board may not approve more than five collaborative agreements with a licensed dentist, not including any collaborative agreements that have been terminated

fields.name: advanced_practice_permit_available
fields.description: Whether the state issues an advanced practice permit or equivalent credential allowing a dental hygienist to provide services to underserved populations without a dentist's physical presence or prior examination.
fields.sample_quote: The board may issue an advanced practice permit to a licensed dental hygienist with a minimum of 4,000 documented hours of clinical experience. A licensed dental hygienist holding an advanced practice permit may provide the services described in (a) of this section to a patient described in (b) of this section without (1) the physical presence, authorization, or supervision of a licensed dentist; (2) a licensed dentist's examination of the patient.

fields.name: advanced_practice_eligible_patient_populations
fields.description: The specific patient populations or settings for which an advanced practice or affiliated practice dental hygienist may provide services without direct dentist supervision.
fields.sample_quote: A licensed dental hygienist holding an advanced practice permit may provide the services described in (a) of this section to a patient who is unable to access dental treatment because of age, infirmity, or disability and is (1) a resident in a senior center, including a hospital, long-term care facility, adult foster home, residential care facility, or adult congregate living facility; (2) a resident in a health care facility; (3) held in a local correctional facility; (4) enrolled in a nursery school, day care program, vocational training facility, primary school, secondary school, private school, or public charter school

fields.name: dental_therapist_license_available
fields.description: Whether the state licenses dental therapists as a distinct mid-level dental provider category with its own scope of practice.
fields.sample_quote: 'Dental therapist' means any person who is licensed and engaged in the general practice of dental therapy and all related and associated duties, including educational, clinical and therapeutic dental therapy procedures.

fields.name: dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_required
fields.description: Whether a dental therapist must operate under a written collaborative practice agreement with a supervising dentist in order to practice independently of direct supervision.
fields.sample_quote: A dental therapist may practice in this state either under the direct supervision of a dentist or pursuant to a written collaborative practice agreement. Before a dental therapist may enter into a written collaborative practice agreement, the dental therapist shall complete one thousand hours of dental therapy clinical practice under the direct supervision of a dentist who is licensed in this state.

fields.name: dental_therapist_practice_setting_restrictions
fields.description: The specific practice settings or facility types in which a dental therapist is authorized to practice.
fields.sample_quote: A dental therapist may practice only in the following practice settings or locations, including mobile dental units, that are operated or served by any of the following: (1) A federally qualified community health center. (2) A health center program that has received a federal look-alike designation. (3) A community health center. (4) A nonprofit dental practice or a nonprofit organization that provides dental care to low-income and underserved individuals.

fields.name: mobile_dental_facility_registration_required
fields.description: Whether operators of mobile dental facilities or portable dental units must register with the state dental board and comply with specific operational requirements.
fields.sample_quote: In order to operate a mobile dental facility or portable dental operation, an operator shall first obtain a certificate of registration issued by the board.

fields.name: mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_required
fields.description: Whether operators of mobile dental facilities are required to maintain a written protocol for emergency follow-up care for patients treated at the mobile facility.
fields.sample_quote: The operator shall maintain a written procedure for emergency follow-up care for patients treated in a mobile dental facility, which includes arrangements for treatment in a dental facility that is permanently established in the area within a 50-mile radius where services are provided.

fields.name: dental_office_ownership_restrictions
fields.description: Whether the state restricts ownership or operation of dental offices to licensed dentists or specified entities, prohibiting non-dentist corporate ownership.
fields.sample_quote: Only a person who holds a valid license issued under this chapter may own, operate, or maintain a dental practice, office, or clinic.

fields.name: opioid_prescribing_limits
fields.description: Whether the state imposes statutory limits on the quantity or duration of opioid prescriptions that a dentist may issue.
fields.sample_quote: A licensee may not issue (1) an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use; (2) a prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to a minor.

fields.name: controlled_substance_database_registration_required
fields.description: Whether dentists who hold a DEA registration number are required to register with or use the state's controlled substance prescription monitoring database.
fields.sample_quote: require that a licensed dentist who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database under AS 17.30.200(n)

fields.name: dental_laboratory_work_authorization_required
fields.description: Whether dentists must provide a written work authorization or prescription to dental laboratories when ordering prosthetic or orthodontic appliances, with specified content requirements.
fields.sample_quote: Every duly licensed and registered dentist who employs the services of a commercial dental laboratory or private technician for the purpose of constructing, altering, repairing, or duplicating any prostheses (fixed or removable), splint, or orthodontic appliance shall be required to furnish the commercial dental laboratory or private technician an impression or cast made by the dentist when necessary, together with a prescription setting forth the following

fields.name: denture_patient_identification_marking_required
fields.description: Whether dentists are required to have complete dentures permanently marked with the patient's name or initials during fabrication for identification purposes.
fields.sample_quote: Every complete upper or lower denture fabricated by a licensed dentist, or fabricated pursuant to the dentist's work order, shall be marked with the patient's name, unless the patient objects. The markings shall be done during fabrication and shall be permanent, legible, and cosmetically acceptable.

fields.name: teledentistry_authorized
fields.description: Whether the state expressly authorizes or defines teledentistry as a permitted mode of delivering dental services.
fields.sample_quote: 'Teledentistry' means the use of data transmitted through interactive audio, video or data communications for the purposes of examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, consultation and directing the delivery of treatment by dentists and dental providers in settings permissible under this chapter or specified in rules adopted by the board.

fields.name: hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification_required
fields.description: Whether dental hygienists must obtain a separate board-issued certificate or permit before they are authorized to administer local anesthesia.
fields.sample_quote: A dental hygienist shall apply to the board for a certificate to administer local anesthetics. The board shall not issue a certificate until the applicant has met the requirements set forth by the board.

fields.name: hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_required
fields.description: Whether dental hygienists must obtain a separate board-issued certificate or permit before they are authorized to administer nitrous oxide analgesia.
fields.sample_quote: if certified by the board and under the direct or indirect supervision of a licensed dentist, administer and monitor nitrous oxide-oxygen conscious sedation

fields.name: restorative_function_endorsement_available
fields.description: Whether the state issues a restorative function endorsement or certificate allowing a dental hygienist or dental assistant to place and finish direct restorations prepared by a dentist.
fields.sample_quote: The board shall issue a restorative function endorsement to a licensed dental hygienist if the licensee furnishes evidence satisfactory to the board that the licensee has (1) successfully completed a course offered by or under the auspices of a program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association or other equivalent course or program approved by the board; and (2) passed the Western Regional Examining Board's restorative examination.

fields.name: interim_therapeutic_restoration_authorized
fields.description: Whether the state expressly authorizes dental hygienists or dental assistants in extended functions to place interim therapeutic restorations using hand instrumentation only.
fields.sample_quote: Place protective restorations, which for this purpose are identified as interim therapeutic restorations, and defined as a direct provisional restoration placed to stabilize the tooth until a licensed dentist diagnoses the need for further definitive treatment. An interim therapeutic restoration consists of the removal of soft material from the tooth using only hand instrumentation, without the use of rotary instrumentation, and subsequent placement of an adhesive restorative material.

fields.name: patient_record_retention_years
fields.description: The minimum number of years a licensee is required to retain patient dental records after the last date of service.
fields.sample_quote: failed to maintain a patient or facility record for at least seven years after the date the record was created

fields.name: cpr_certification_required_for_sedation
fields.description: Whether dentists and auxiliary personnel involved in sedation procedures are required to maintain current certification in basic or advanced cardiac life support.
fields.sample_quote: Any dentist using general anesthesia, and his or her auxiliary personnel shall be currently certified in cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

fields.name: dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_license
fields.description: Whether the state issues a distinct 'alternative practice' or equivalent license category allowing dental hygienists to practice independently in specified community or public health settings without a supervising dentist on-site.
fields.sample_quote: The dental hygiene board shall license as a registered dental hygienist in alternative practice a person who demonstrates satisfactory performance on an examination in California law and ethics required by the dental hygiene board
